title: Administrative Core
summary: Oversees project coordination, budgeting, and reporting across the research group.
body: The Administrative Core manages the day-to-day operations of the research group, including grant administration, scheduling, and communication with partner institutions.

title: Data Management and Analysis Core
summary: Handles data collection standards, storage, and statistical analysis across projects.
body: This core maintains data quality standards, manages the group's data repositories, and provides statistical and GIS analysis support across all active research projects.

title: Community Engagement Core
summary: Coordinates outreach and engagement with communities affected by the group's research.
body: The Community Engagement Core builds relationships with local communities, conducts participatory research activities, and ensures findings are communicated back to stakeholders.

title: Research Experience and Training Coordination Core
summary: Coordinates training and research experience opportunities for students and staff.
body: This core designs and coordinates training programs, mentorship opportunities, and research experiences for graduate and undergraduate students in the group.
